description: Defines the TemplateImage class, a PHP class extending TemplateText, for handling image field templates in SuiteCRM, including field definition and property setting.

classes.name: TemplateImage
classes.description: A PHP class for image field templates in SuiteCRM, managing properties like border, width, height, and type, and generating field definitions.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Generates and returns the field definition array for the image field, including properties like border, width, height, type, and database type.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the mapping of class properties to external variable definitions.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets class properties based on provided values and external variables, updating border, width, and height accordingly.
